product_one_liner.value: Advocate uses AI to turn complex commercial-insurance policies into standardized data and benchmark coverage and pricing for brokers, commercial lenders and loan servicers, carriers, and property owners.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists Free, Starter, Professional, Premium, and Enterprise plans.

named_customers.notes: Both are named under “Trusted by leading financial institutions.”

employee_band.notes: The company profile lists 74 employees, which falls in the 51-100 band.

hq_location.notes: The company says it is headquartered in New York City; its profile identifies the United States.

founded_year.notes: The company profile reports it was founded in 2020.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index reports one post, a company/funding announcement, rather than an engineering blog with multiple technical build posts.

public_docs.notes: The API reference has multiple articles and guides, including authentication, query parameters, rate limits, custom metadata, and case-creation flows.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The five open titles are Platform Engineer, Product Engineer (two postings), Client Solutions Manager, and Insurance Consultant; none is an AI/ML or data-science role title.

model_provider.value: Anthropic and OpenAI (named as inference providers; specific model names are not disclosed).
model_provider.notes: The security page says inference runs with frontier model providers such as Anthropic and OpenAI.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page identifies the ISO certificate and says the SOC 2 Type II report is available.

last_funding.notes: The company announcement says the $18 million seed funding was alongside its public launch on August 4, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The $18 million seed round was announced August 4, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current five job titles include no SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The product-release page announces AIR (Beta Release), a new conversational agent for building insurance requirements, on October 23, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The CTO’s LinkedIn experience lists Advocate Technologies through September 2026 and a new role beginning October 2026; the profile headline still names Advocate, so the change is based on the dated experience history.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job board and API documentation name no specific CRM or sales/marketing system; one job description refers only generically to “CRM platforms.”
